name: home-page
title: Home page
description: The home page template, built only from library items: the search on a band of the light, the index as a corridor, what it does, the numbers, agents around the lockup, one customer and the offer.
use_for: A website's home. Add it, then edit the copy in lib/pages/home.ts or pass `content`; the sections are library items you can reorder or drop.
never: New colors, shadows or type sizes added to a section: use the items' props
More than one White button in a section
Invented numbers in the stat block
source: Built from the library (site header, hero block, search bar, creative grid, creative corridor, card, stat block, creative ring, testimonial, offer block, footer row); the story follows the social ads; the copy is the assets' own lines (Ad, The only creative search engine; Ad, The world's largest creative search engine; Posts) and Acme placeholders

import { Button } from '@/react/components/ui/Button' import { Card } from '@/react/components/ui/Card' import { SearchBar } from '@/react/components/product/SearchBar' import { CreativeCorridor } from '@/react/components/site/CreativeCorridor' import { CreativeGrid } from '@/react/components/site/CreativeGrid' import { CreativeRing } from '@/react/components/site/CreativeRing' import { FooterRow } from '@/react/components/site/FooterRow' import { SiteHeader } from '@/react/components/site/SiteHeader' import { Testimonial } from '@/react/components/site/Testimonial' import { HeroBlock } from '@/react/components/blocks/HeroBlock' import { OfferBlock } from '@/react/components/blocks/OfferBlock' import { StatBlock } from '@/react/components/blocks/StatBlock' import { Logo } from '@/react/components/visuals/Logo' import { homeContent, type HomeContent } from '@/lib/pages/home' import { cn } from '@/react/lib/cn' // The home page, built only from library items, in the order the ads tell the story: the search (the hero on a band // of the light, three creatives under it), the index (the corridor), what it does (three cards), the numbers, agents // (the ring), one customer, and the offer. `content` replaces the copy (lib/pages/home.ts holds the template's). export interface HomePageProps { content?: HomeContent className?: string } const WRAP = 'mx-auto w-full max-w-page-wide px-12 max-sm:px-4' export function HomePage({ content: c = homeContent, className }: HomePageProps) { return (
{c.hero.action.label}} light="band" seed={2} texture>

{c.index.headline}

{c.index.body}

{c.features.map((f) => )}

{c.agents.headline}

) } export default HomePage

// The home page template's copy. Lines in quotes on the brand assets are used as they are (headlines, the ad copy,
// the Creator plan); the rest is neutral template copy and Acme placeholders to replace. Both flavors read this file.
/** An Acme placeholder creative: the advertiser, a neutral tone (1 to 4) and a headline. */
const creative = (brand: string, tone: 1 | 2 | 3 | 4, caption?: string) => (caption ? { brand, tone, caption } : { brand, tone })

export const homeContent = {
	nav: [
		{ label: 'Product', href: '/product' },
		{ label: 'Pricing', href: '/pricing' },
		{ label: 'Changelog', href: '/changelog' },
		{ label: 'Blog', href: '/blog' },
	],
	secondary: { label: 'Sign in', href: '/sign-in' },
	cta: { label: 'Get 50% off', href: '/pricing' },
	hero: {
		headline: 'The only creative search engine.',
		body: 'AI search across millions of creatives. Ask a question and get instant, structured results.',
		action: { label: 'Get 50% off', href: '/pricing' },
		search: 'Show me UGC ads for skincare brands using before/after hooks',
	},
	results: [
		creative('Acme Skin', 3, 'Glow in two steps.'),
		creative('Acme Skin', 2, 'The travel kit.'),
		creative('Acme Skin', 4, 'Night repair.'),
	],
	index: {
		headline: 'The world’s largest creative search engine.',
		body: 'Meta, TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube creatives in one index.',
		corridor: [
			creative('Acme Studio', 3),
			creative('Acme Studio', 2),
			creative('Acme Fit', 4),
			creative('Acme Drinks', 3),
			creative('Acme Skin', 2),
			creative('Acme Fit', 1),
		],
	},
	features: [
		{ title: 'Know what changed before your next meeting.', body: 'Spyglass follows the brands, creators, and niches that matter to you then turns the changes into a brief you actually want to read.' },
		{ title: 'Understand what is working in any category.', body: 'Compare brands, creators, campaigns, and formats to uncover what is gaining traction, what is falling behind, and why.' },
		{ title: 'Search millions of creators in one place.', body: 'Spyglass monitors millions of brands and creators across Meta Ads, Instagram, and TikTok.' },
	],
	stats: {
		title: 'Every creative in one place.',
		items: [
			{ value: '4', label: 'Networks in one index: Meta, TikTok, Instagram and YouTube.' },
			{ value: '1 min', label: 'To add any brand or creator.' },
			{ value: 'Unlimited', label: 'Team seats on the Creator plan.' },
			{ value: '$10', label: 'For your first month, then $20/month.' },
		],
	},
	agents: {
		headline: 'Give your agents access to Instagram and TikTok.',
		ring: [
			creative('Acme Skin', 4),
			creative('Acme Studio', 2),
			creative('Acme Motors', 3),
			creative('Acme Fit', 1),
			creative('Acme Drinks', 3),
			creative('Acme Drinks', 4),
			creative('Acme Motors', 2),
			creative('Acme Fit', 3),
		],
	},
	testimonial: { quote: 'We see every launch in our category the day it goes live.', name: 'Alex Rivera', position: 'Head of growth, Acme' },
	offer: { headline: 'Stop screenshotting at midnight.', note: '$10 for your first month, then $20/month', cta: { label: 'Start Creator for 50% off', href: '/pricing' } },
	footer: {
		domain: 'spyglass.so',
		links: [
			{ label: 'Product', href: '/product' },
			{ label: 'Pricing', href: '/pricing' },
			{ label: 'About', href: '/about' },
			{ label: 'Changelog', href: '/changelog' },
			{ label: 'Blog', href: '/blog' },
			{ label: 'Terms', href: '/legal' },
		],
	},
}

export type HomeContent = typeof homeContent

import { html } from 'lit' import { DsElement, define, HostLayoutController } from '@/elements/lib/element' import { homeContent, type HomeContent } from '@/lib/pages/home' import '@/elements/components/ui/button' import '@/elements/components/ui/card' import '@/elements/components/product/search-bar' import '@/elements/components/site/creative-corridor' import '@/elements/components/site/creative-grid' import '@/elements/components/site/creative-ring' import '@/elements/components/site/footer-row' import '@/elements/components/site/site-header' import '@/elements/components/site/testimonial' import '@/elements/components/blocks/hero-block' import '@/elements/components/blocks/offer-block' import '@/elements/components/blocks/stat-block' import '@/elements/components/visuals/logo' import styles from 'virtual:tw' // HomePage.tsx as : the home page template from the library's elements. `content` (an object, as // lib/pages/home.ts) replaces the copy. const WRAP = 'mx-auto w-full max-w-page-wide px-12 max-sm:px-4' /** * @summary The home page template. */ export class HomePage extends DsElement { static styles = [DsElement.styles, styles] protected readonly layout = new HostLayoutController(this, () => this.renderRoot.querySelector('[data-ds="home-page"]')) static properties = { content: { type: Object } } /** The page's copy (lib/pages/home.ts by default). */ content: HomeContent = homeContent render() { const c = this.content ?? homeContent return html`
${c.hero.action.label}

${c.index.headline}

${c.index.body}

${c.features.map((f) => html``)}

${c.agents.headline}

` } } define('home-page', HomePage)
